notes.title: Unstuck Update
notes.notes:
We’ve been gathering feedback and analyzing data over the past few months. The feedback has been overwhelmingly positive, for which we are very grateful. However, our data has revealed a slight issue: the game is too difficult. While we intended for the game to be challenging, it appears we might have overdone it.

Currently, only about 30% of players make it past B9 (halfway through the game), and only 5% manage to finish the game. Some levels are particularly easy to get stuck on, and since there aren't many ways to progress, getting stuck usually means game over. We wanted to address this issue and offer more paths forward. Here’s what we’ve done:


 Dropped hints across the more challenging production lines
 Completely redesigned the level unlocking system, making it non-linear (see screenshot)
 Added 6 practice levels to the B set to provide useful insights


Additionally, this update includes:


 2 bonus levels (AZ, BZ)
 3 new achievements
 More animations


If you’re stuck, update the game and see if it helps. If you’re not stuck, congratulations! And if you haven’t gotten the game yet, it will be on sale soon!

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: First patch
notes.notes:
Added controller support (experimental for now; the default mapping may change)
 Improved game- and level-loading speed (level transitions should be smooth now)
 Tutorial texts can now be disabled in the settings (at your own risk)
 Benchmark level does not grant achievements anymore
 In comparison, the full game now grants achievements for progress in the demo
 The dates of saved solutions are now displayed in local time instead of UTC
 The outline of the selected Input gate now renders correctly
 Enhanced UI for keyboard and controller and minor UI improvements
 Minor changes in tutorial and hints
